items.title: No email needed for a wish
items.body: When you send a wish or a video wish, you now only enter your name. The event owner sees who it is from, and we no longer ask for an email we never used.

releases.title: Shared links now take you to the right page

items.title: Your link survives the install
items.body: If you open a Connekyt link or scan a QR code before you have the app, it now takes you to that page after you install and sign up.

items.title: Clearer countdown on offer calls
items.body: The time left on an incoming offer is now shown as days, hours, minutes and seconds, so you can see exactly how long you have to answer.

releases.title: Currency flags, a clearer event page and a fixed Withdraw screen

items.title: Real flags on every currency
items.body: Every place you pick a currency now shows its flag next to the code, so RWF, USD, EUR and the rest are easy to tell apart, even offline.

items.title: Countdown and date in one card
items.body: The event page now shows the countdown, the date, the time and the venue together in a single card, counted to the event's own time zone.

items.title: Past events show as ended
items.body: An event whose date has passed now says Ended on its own page, the same as in the list, instead of Upcoming with a Get notified button.

items.title: Ongoing events are red
items.body: Ongoing events now use the same red as Go Live on the Events screen, the home screen and the event page, so live things stand out.

items.title: Withdraw shows what you can really withdraw
items.body: The booking balance is now called Booking earnings, empty balances are hidden, and the total you can withdraw is shown across all your sources.

items.title: Self-streamed events in your own currency
items.body: When you stream an event yourself you can pick the fee currency, and coordinators follow the same rules and 100 minimum as clients.

items.title: Photographers create events in one place
items.body: Create event now opens Host an event for photographers, so there is a single, simpler way to start an event and go live.

items.title: No more Send to Client on paid albums
items.body: Standalone paid albums no longer offer Send to Client, because they are published instead, so you will not hit an error.

items.title: Gift totals in the right currency
items.body: The gift total on Payments is now added up per currency, and a gift priced in dollars is labelled in dollars.

releases.title: A faster, clearer Events screen for photographers

items.title: Tabs that fit your work
items.body: Your events, bookings and opportunities now sit in four equal tabs along the top, so you can reach each one with a single tap.

items.title: Filter by status
items.body: Narrow the list to upcoming, live or ended events, or to the ones waiting for your answer, and see a helpful message when nothing matches.

items.title: An optional calendar
items.body: Switch to a month, week or agenda view when you want to plan by date. Pick a day to filter the list, and remove the date with one tap.

items.title: Quick actions on press and hold
items.body: Each event row is more compact. Press and hold it for stream, album, QR code and remove, while Accept and Deny stay on pending requests.

releases.title: Share your albums with a link or QR code

items.title: Link and QR for Find My Photos
items.body: When an album is live on Find My Photos, open it and tap Share to get a QR code and a link. Attendees scan or open it, take a selfie and find their photos.

items.title: Paid albums go live on their own
items.body: A paid personal album is now published to Find My Photos as soon as its photos are uploaded, with the price you set, and the share sheet opens right away.

items.title: Set a price before publishing an event album
items.body: The first time you publish an event album, you choose the price per photo and its currency, the same as on the web dashboard.

items.title: The Connekyt logo in every QR code
items.body: Every QR code in the app, and the ones you save, now carries the Connekyt logo in the middle and still scans.
